name: Counter Dashboard — Recount rejected item and resubmit
description: Counter logs in with test_counter, opens rejected item TS-ITEM-002, inputs recount value 55, and resubmits to supervisor.

planSteps.description: Navigate to the login page at /login
Enter test_counter into the username field and Test@123456 into the password field
Locate the item TS-ITEM-002 in the counter list and click to open its detail
Enter 55 into the counted quantity input field
Enter شمارش مجدد انجام شد into the counter note textarea
Click the submit button labelled ثبت و ارسال به سرپرست
Verify that the item TS-ITEM-002 detail closes or a success message is shown indicating recount submission
